subject: Mobile Development
title: Phishing Attacks on Mobile
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Phishing Attacks on Mobile.

hook.text: You get a text from your bank asking you to verify your account. It's not your bank.

buildup.text: SMS phishing — smishing — sends fake messages with links to credential-stealing websites.

discovery.text: Mobile browsers hide full URLs, making it harder to spot fake domains than on desktop.

twist.text: Mobile phishing success rates are 3x higher than email phishing because users tap without thinking.

climax.text: Phishing exploits trust and urgency. On mobile, the small screen amplifies both.

punchline.text: On a tiny screen, fake and real look the same.

quiz.question: Why is mobile phishing more effective than email phishing?
options: Small screens hide URLs and users tap impulsively
